title: Offset panel share breakdown rise
summary: A small chart title holds alone on charcoal, then five offset colour panels rise from a baseline one after another, pushing the title to the top while each panel's percentage rolls up from zero. A silent 4 s share reveal.
use_when: Showing how one total splits into 3 to 6 parts (revenue, usage, audience)
A vertical social post or story slide with one data reveal
A proof beat inside a longer film where a breakdown backs a claim
Silent autoplay where the numbers must carry the message

look.type_style: neutral grotesk; title regular sentence case ~2.5 % H in white; figures heavy grotesk ~7 % H in near-black with a superscript percent sign at ~45 % of figure size; category label regular ~1.6 % H under each figure

sfx.event: each panel lands on the stack

structure.shot: charcoal frame; chart title, 2 words, left, and a small brand glyph right, on one line at mid height
structure.camera: locked off: no zoom or pan (elements move, frame does not)
structure.motion: title words rise in with a small stagger (second word lower at 0.27 s), settled by 0.50 s: springs.snappy ~8 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); glyph fades in with it; title drifts up ~3 % H over 0.27-1.25 s, easings.linear

structure.shot: a thin white baseline rule appears near the bottom; first two offset panels rise from it, figures at zero
structure.camera: locked off: no zoom or pan (elements move, frame does not)
structure.motion: baseline at 1.27 s; panels rise from the bottom edge in a cascade, stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s), springs.layout; title travels with the stack from 50 % to 15 % H, easings.outExpo ~18 fr (±0.25 s); figures start rolling from 0

structure.shot: five offset panels fill the lower 85 % of the frame, each with a white top rule, figure and label; title reaches the top
structure.camera: locked off: no zoom or pan (elements move, frame does not)
structure.motion: panels keep growing upward to final heights, springs.layout, settle ~2.40 s (overshoot not measurable); figures roll up, top panel lands first at 2.50 s, easings.outExpo; title settles at 5 % H

structure.shot: finished breakdown: five panels with percentages and category labels under the title
structure.camera: locked off: no zoom or pan (elements move, frame does not)
structure.motion: remaining figures land by 2.77 s (last +1 to +2 each); then full hold 37 fr, nothing moves

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, display font; panel colours from a 5-colour list
params.content.title: chart title, 1-3 words
params.content.items: 3-6 parts: {value (percent), label (2-3 words), color?}, largest first

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). No hard cuts; the analyser's soft transition 1.47-2.23 s is the panel stack sweeping in, not a scene change. Panels: each one offset right/down from the previous, overlapping, thin white top rule, 1 px dark outline. Figures roll from 0 and land in order, top panel first (2.50 s), others by 2.77 s. motion.json reports zoom -5 %/s in 2-4 s but sheet cells 3.00-3.77 are identical: no camera move. Proposed term stack-cascade (offset overlapping panels rising from a baseline), not in vocabulary. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
